stars.title: Red Dwarf
stars.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-quality raster star sprite for the dark galaxy map of the science-fiction strategy game Stellar Syndicates.
Primary request: a fresh, beautiful, cohesive replacement for one astronomical map icon.
Composition: one isolated astronomical object centered exactly in a square 1024 by 1024 canvas, straight-on orthographic-like astronomy view. Main silhouette about 62% of the canvas width, the entire soft corona within 84%; leave clean transparent padding all around. It must read immediately at 32–72 screen pixels, with richer detail visible at 256 pixels.
Style: premium space-strategy art, physically inspired luminous plasma, exceptionally clean edges and smooth fine detail, restrained cinematic glow. NOT brush-painted, NOT crayon, NOT flat emoji, NOT a UI badge. Self-luminous, not a planet illuminated on one side.
Backdrop: genuinely TRANSPARENT PNG alpha, including empty areas between jets or separate bodies. Glows must fade smoothly to alpha zero. No black background baked into the sprite, no checkerboard drawn in.
Constraints: no text, no labels, no orbit or selection rings, no border, no emblem, no ships, no planets, no starfield, no surrounding nebula, no arbitrary lens flare cross or long decorative spikes. No cropped rays. One asset only, not a sheet.
Subject: A compact red dwarf star: saturated crimson and ember-red photosphere with orange-red luminous granulation, a few small bright active regions and short localized magnetic prominences, small tight deep-red corona. It is unmistakably a living star, not a rocky lava planet. Keep the surface mostly luminous ruby red rather than predominantly orange or white. The solid sphere is the main readable shape.
